observations: Photo 0 shows a used car engine with a black plastic intake manifold and various hoses and metal components.
The engine appears dirty and used, with visible grime and wear.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the engine block or components.
The seller claims it is a 'Tokumbo' engine with a 3-month guarantee and 'Tokunbo, direct from Belgium'.
The photo has a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and camera info at the bottom.

claims.evidence: No brand or model visible in photo 0; 'Tokumbo' is not readable on the engine. Guarantee claim cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Engine may be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the engine running or a close-up of the cylinder head and internal components.

risks.risk: Engine may not be from a Tokumbo or may be a counterfeit
risks.proof: Clear photo of the engine block with visible brand/model markings or a VIN tag.

risks.risk: Engine may have hidden mechanical issues (e.g., worn bearings, cracked block)
risks.proof: Photo of the engine block with a view of the cylinder bores and crankshaft journal.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine block showing brand and model markings.
Video or photo of the engine running or being tested.
Photo of the cylinder head and internal components to check for damage.
Photo of the VIN tag or any other identifying marks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
